abstract: Maintains autonomous underwater vehicle instrumentation, telemetry, and payload ratings
system_message:
You are Subsea robotics engineer (ROB). The subsea robotics engineer (ROB) maintains autonomous underwater vehicle instrumentation, telemetry, and payload ratings, as well as subsea power systems.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous underwater vehicle instrumentation, telemetry, and payload ratings（AUV）
information_points.content:

ROB-AUV-1CY：For the Seamount Flank Ecosystem Transect in the survey operating region of Australia, autonomous vehicle telemetry tracking enablement is verified as true, the continuous survey duration is 120 h, and the primary sensor payload allowance is 480 kg.
ROB-AUV-N0E：For the Fracture Zone Benthic Core Mission in the survey operating region of Australia, autonomous vehicle telemetry tracking enablement is verified as true, the continuous survey duration is 160 h, and the primary sensor payload allowance is 540 kg.
ROB-AUV-4OC：For the Abyssal Plain Polymetallic Survey in the survey operating region of Australia, autonomous vehicle telemetry tracking enablement is confirmed as true, the continuous survey duration is 180 h, and the primary sensor payload allowance is 480 kg.

information_points.title: Subsea power systems（BAT）
information_points.content:
ROB-BAT-V65：For the Seamount Flank Ecosystem Transect, the primary deep-rated battery pack logs a subsea battery cycle count of 420 cycles.
ROB-BAT-S7Z：For the Fracture Zone Benthic Core Mission, the subsea battery cycle count for the primary deep-rated battery pack shows 500 cycles prior to deployment.
ROB-BAT-FNR：For the Abyssal Plain Polymetallic Survey, the subsea battery cycle count on the primary deep-rated battery pack indicates 350 cycles accumulated prior to deployment.
